label: Liberation Day Tariffs — April 2
description: Sweeping reciprocal tariffs take effect Apr 2. VIX above 30, worst-case pricing across equities. Sectors most exposed: autos, semis, consumer electronics.

label: S&P 500 Down 9.4% From ATH
description: S&P 500 at 6,344, down 9.4% from Feb all-time high of 7,002. Nasdaq -13.4%. Bear market territory approaching for growth names.

label: VIX Above 30 — Risk-Off Regime
description: VIX at 30.61, up 18% this week. Above 28 = risk-off regime. Put/call ratios elevated. Market pricing recession + tariff shock.

label: Oil Supply Shock — WTI $102+
description: WTI crude at $102.60, USO surging +12.67% weekly. Largest weekly oil move since March 2022. Supply fears + OPEC discipline + geopolitical tensions.

label: Gold ATH $4,590 — Safe Haven Rush
description: Gold futures at $4,590, record highs. Driven by tariff uncertainty, central bank buying, declining real rates. Silver at $72.20 also surging.

label: China PMI Returns to Expansion
description: China Manufacturing PMI 50.4 (vs 50.1 expected, prev 49.0). Non-manufacturing 50.1. Possible front-loading of exports before tariffs.

label: EU CPI Flash — March Release Today
description: Eurozone flash CPI for March due today. Below expectations strengthens ECB rate cut case for April meeting. Key for EUR/USD.

label: Q1 End — Rebalancing Flows
description: Last trading day of Q1 2026. Pension fund and institutional rebalancing creating mechanical flows. Stocks down = potential buy pressure.

label: China Retaliation Risk
description: Beijing signaling readiness for targeted countermeasures on US agriculture and energy if Liberation Day tariffs proceed as planned.

label: NFP & ISM This Week
description: Non-Farm Payrolls (Fri Apr 3), ISM Manufacturing (Wed Apr 1), ADP Employment (Thu Apr 2). Critical labor + activity data amid tariff chaos.

label: Long TLT — Bond Rally Trade
description: TLT up 1.33%, bouncing off 52W low. If tariffs trigger recession scare, Fed forced to cut. Entry $86.80, TP $90-94.

label: Short QQQ — Tech Breakdown
description: Nasdaq -13.4% from ATH, sell-the-rally pattern persisting. Most exposed to tariff supply chain disruption. Short entry $560, TP $520-540.

label: German Retail Sales Miss
description: German retail sales -0.6% MoM (expected +0.3%). Consumer weakness in Europe's largest economy. German unemployment data due today.

label: UK GDP Stagnation
description: UK Q4 GDP +0.1% QoQ in line. Growth stagnating. Business investment -2.5% QoQ. Nationwide HPI surprised up +0.9% MoM.

label: Russell 2000 Weakness
description: Small caps leading the decline, Russell 2000 -1.46% Monday, -2.71% weekly. Most sensitive to domestic economic weakness.

label: BTC Digital Gold Thesis Test
description: Bitcoin holding $67K while equities sell off. Testing digital gold narrative. Key level: $65K support. Break below invalidates thesis.

label: Defensive Rotation Pattern
description: Clear rotation from growth → value → defensives. Money flowing to gold, energy, bonds. Growth and small caps being sold. Pre-crisis pattern.

label: Japan Nikkei -13.4% From 52W High
description: Nikkei 225 at 51,361, down from 59,332 peak. Tariff overhang hits export-heavy Japan. JGB yields rising (2Y at 1.37%).

label: Silver Breakout — $72.20
description: Silver futures at $72.20 (+2.67%). Riding gold's coattails with industrial demand kicker. SLV ETF at $63.52.

label: Energy Sector Outperformance
description: USO +4.53% Monday, +12.67% weekly. Energy is the top-performing sector as oil supply concerns persist above $100/bbl.

label: European Outperformance
description: FTSE +1.61%, DAX +1.18%, CAC +0.92% vs US weakness. Rotation from overvalued US mega-caps to European value. Euro weakness boosting exporters.
